message.content: **Columbia University** is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the U.S., known for its rigorous academics, distinguished faculty, and notable alumni. Columbia offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across a wide range of disciplines, including arts and sciences, business (via Columbia Business School), law (via Columbia Law School), medicine (via Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians & Surgeons), journalism (via Columbia Journalism School), and engineering (via Columbia Engineering). The campus is primarily situated in Morningside Heights, Manhattan, with additional facilities in other parts of New York City.
